AMENDMENT_1_norm_controlled_readout.amendment: a second, norm-controlled readout is computed for every axis on every member: cos = (h . u) / ||h||. The AUROC of ||h|| alone is also reported as a named baseline.
AMENDMENT_1_norm_controlled_readout.diagnosis: a raw projection is ||h|| * cos(angle), so every direction -- including a random one -- inherits any refusal-versus-compliance difference in the residual-stream NORM. This is a magnitude channel, not a direction finding.
AMENDMENT_1_norm_controlled_readout.not_done: no verdict threshold, no panel membership and no headline was changed; the K/M count is reported under BOTH readouts.
AMENDMENT_1_norm_controlled_readout.trigger: the pre-registered P8 sanity gate fired exactly as designed: the matched RANDOM axis D read refusal at AUROC 0.171 with a prompt-clustered CI of [0.076, 0.290], which excludes 0.50
AMENDMENT_1_norm_controlled_readout.what_is_primary: the pre-registered stratum-centred PROJECTION readout remains the pre-registered primary and is reported unchanged. The norm-controlled readout is the primary for the P8 SANITY GATE only (a random axis must not read once the shared magnitude channel is removed), and is reported beside the primary in every table so a reader can see both.
AMENDMENT_1_norm_controlled_readout.when: after the FIRST member (Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B) and before any other member was measured; no comparison across members existed yet

AMENDMENT_2_empirical_random_null.amendment: 20 fresh random unit directions are pushed through the identical pipeline per member (raw-projection and norm-controlled readouts both), and the P8 gate now asks whether axis D sits OUTSIDE that measured spread instead of whether its CI excludes 0.50. Costs 20 dot products and no extra forward passes.
AMENDMENT_2_empirical_random_null.backfill: members measured before this amendment were re-run through axes + detection ONLY (--refresh-detection), preserving their existing induction sweeps, so the null is present for every member on the identical code path.
AMENDMENT_2_empirical_random_null.diagnosis: one random draw is not a null distribution. Residual streams are strongly anisotropic, so the isotropic intuition that a random direction sits at 0.50 is simply wrong; the spread of achievable random AUROCs is wide and must be measured, not assumed.
AMENDMENT_2_empirical_random_null.trigger: the P8 gate fired again, now on the norm-controlled readout: a single random direction read at AUROC 0.698 [0.632, 0.764] on one member and 0.348 [0.240, 0.423] on another
AMENDMENT_2_empirical_random_null.what_is_primary: unchanged. This alters only the SANITY GATE's reference distribution; no axis verdict threshold, no K/M count and no headline is affected.
AMENDMENT_2_empirical_random_null.when: after 14 members, before any headline was written

AMENDMENT_3_base_model_renderer.amendment: the renderer is chosen by MEMBER CLASS: member_class == 'base' uses the plain 'User: ... Assistant:' wrapper, everything else uses the chat template. The five base members were re-measured from scratch (axes, detection AND induction).
AMENDMENT_3_base_model_renderer.diagnosis: the renderer was selected as 'auto', i.e. use the chat template when the tokenizer ships one. Qwen3-*-Base tokenizers DO ship a chat template even though the base model was never tuned to follow one, so the base checkpoints were rendered in ChatML. The archive pins base -> plain wrapper (iter_2 MODEL_CFG).
AMENDMENT_3_base_model_renderer.note: this is the failure mode the fallback plan predicted for a low axis cosine -- 'a wrong layer or a wrong renderer for a base model'. The gate caught it; it was not caught by any headline number, which is the point of having the gate.
AMENDMENT_3_base_model_renderer.outcome: both archived base checkpoints then reproduced at cosine 0.99999 and 0.99998, so all six archived checkpoints pass the gate.
AMENDMENT_3_base_model_renderer.trigger: the gate PASSED on all four archived CHAT checkpoints (axis A cosine 1.0000, axis E 0.9999) and FAILED on both archived BASE checkpoints (axis E cosine 0.127 and 0.094)
AMENDMENT_3_base_model_renderer.when: after the full panel, when the axis-reproduction gate was read

P1_panel_rule.anchor_exception: mlabonne/Qwen3-0.6B-abliterated is not a manifest row (it predates the manifest); it is carried explicitly from lib/panel.py as the reproduction control
P1_panel_rule.eligibility: panel_manifest rows with verified=true, gated=false, param_count <= 4.2e9, n_layers >= 8
P1_panel_rule.hard_rule: no candidate is silently dropped; the loads/skips table is a headline deliverable
load_priority: 1 the two breadth-panel members on which archived axis B reaches 0.50 (unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct = l3_instruct, archived B max rate 0.633; Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct = l4_instruct, archived B max rate 0.667)
2 abliterated-class members whose lineage already has a parent queued
3 remaining abliterated-class members, smallest params first
4 remaining in-lineage parents (one instruct + one base per lineage)

wording_ladder.3<=K<6: on K of M, reported as a case series
wording_ladder.K<3: the abliterated arm could NOT be strengthened; the iteration-3 n=2 claim must be DOWNGRADED in the paper
wording_ladder.K>=6: the canonical refusal axis is at chance in BOTH roles on K of M abliterated checkpoints

P2_layer_rule.correction_to_the_artifact_plan: the plan asserted the archived tie-break was relative depth 0.30. It is 0.25. 0.25 is pre-registered because it is what the archive actually used and is what makes the axis reproduction gate meaningful; the discrepancy is reported rather than silently resolved.
P2_layer_rule.never: the layer is NEVER re-selected from an outcome
P2_layer_rule.provenance: the ARCHIVED relative depth, read off iter_2/gen_art/gen_art_experiment_1/results/model_*.json: all six archived checkpoints have L=7 of n_layers=28, i.e. EXACTLY 0.25
P2_layer_rule.rule: L = round(RELATIVE_DEPTH * n_layers), clipped to [1, n_layers-1]

escalation_ladder: rung 1: 4 more temperature-0.7 seeds on the harmful core-80 only
rung 2: up to 200 further plain_harmful rows beyond the core-80
P3_powered_rule.never: the 40-item floor is never lowered and classes are never rebalanced by up-weighting; the imbalance is reported instead
P3_powered_rule.rule: a member is POWERED iff >= 40 refusal AND >= 40 compliance items survive the exclusion cascade
P3_powered_rule.unpowered_members: reported in full but excluded from the K/M verdict counts

P4_at_chance_definition.centring: projections are STRATUM-CENTRED (harmless / harmful / xstest) before pooling, so a prompt-topic offset cannot inflate AUROC; the raw uncentred AUROC is reported alongside but is never primary
P4_at_chance_definition.ci: prompt-clustered bootstrap, 2000 reps, resampling PROMPTS with replacement (not items), seed 20260812
P4_at_chance_definition.paired_A_minus_B: computed on the SAME resampled prompts; Holm-corrected across members

P5_induction_grid.c_50: non-parametric linear interpolation of the 0.50 crossing (lib.dose.nonparametric_alpha50); None = 'never crosses'
P5_induction_grid.capped_cells: recorded as 'capped' and excluded from the matched-contrast average rather than clipped
P5_induction_grid.contrast_unit_formula: c = alpha * NORM_L / ||d_raw||   <=>   alpha = c * ||d_raw|| / NORM_L
P5_induction_grid.formula_verification: reproduces the archived analysis2.json contrast_units exactly: instruct_0p6 axis A, alpha 0.5, NORM_L 21.135299682617188, ||d_raw|| 10.632234573364258 -> c = 0.9939255730665065 (archived value identical)

matched_contrast_verdicts.B_IS_A_GENUINE_INDUCER: B reaches 0.50 at matched contrast AND the delta CI includes 0
matched_contrast_verdicts.NORM_MISMATCH_DOES_NOT_EXPLAIN: CI lower bound of the paired A-B delta > 0

P5_induction_grid.rollouts: 12 archived benign probe prompts x 3 seeds x 13 c-values per axis, 48 new tokens, temperature 0.7
P5_induction_grid.why: a fixed c means the INJECTED vector carries the same norm relative to the axis's OWN contrast magnitude, which is what removes the magnitude-collapse rival (arXiv:2603.22061) as an explanation of an A-versus-B induction gap

P6_refusal_criterion.invariant: NO headline number may change because of the judge
P6_refusal_criterion.judge: OpenRouter judge on a stratified subsample ONLY, cache-first; Cohen's kappa(regex, judge) reported; hard cap $1.50, abort at $1.40
P6_refusal_criterion.primary: anchored REFUSAL_RE (lib/classify.py, case-sensitive, 27 frozen openers) on the first generated tokens -- deterministic

P7_joint_scatter.no_slicing: any post-hoc subgroup is labelled EXPLORATORY in both JSON and prose
P7_joint_scatter.null_sentence: if the CI includes 0, write 'induction quality and detection quality on the same axis are UNCORRELATED across N pairs', explicitly, as the answer to the Discussion's own question. A null here is a result, not a failure.
P7_joint_scatter.pre_committed_sentence: across N (member, axis) pairs over L lineages, induction quality and detection quality are correlated at rho = X [lo, hi]
P7_joint_scatter.statistic: Spearman rho with a LINEAGE bootstrap (resample lineage_ids with replacement, 2000 reps) + a within-member rank correlation
P7_joint_scatter.x_primary: max refusal rate over the uncapped c-grid (defined in every cell)
P7_joint_scatter.x_secondary: -log10(c_50) on the uncensored subset; the censoring fraction ('never crosses') is stated

P8_sanity_panel.hard_stop: a random axis D with detection CI excluding 0.50 OR max refusal rate >= 0.10 means the pipeline is leaking; that member is flagged D_VIOLATION
P8_sanity_panel.rule: axes C (stylistic) and D (matched random) must stay at chance in BOTH roles on every member

P9_deviations_declared_up_front: dtype is bfloat16 for every member (the archived EVALUATION dtype, which is what the axis-reproduction gate is measured against). iteration-3's experiment_1 used float32 for its own generation arms; mixing is avoided by using bf16 uniformly here and reporting it.
the scored text is the model's OWN generation on the frozen prompt sets, never an archived generation and never an axis-fit string.
the scored sequence is built by TOKEN-ID concatenation, never string concatenation; the number of items on which the two paths differ is counted.
registered_before: any detection AUROC or induction sweep on any member outside the six archived checkpoints
